- `pub fn export_pool(pool: & str) -> Result < () , PoolError >` — _Exports the specified ZFS backup pool (`sudo zpool export <pool>`)._
- `pub fn replicate_all_datasets(config: & BackupConfig, backup_pool: & str) -> Result < Vec < DatasetReplicationReport > , BackupError >` — _Replicates all datasets configured in `config` to `backup_pool` under the resolved machine name._

## 2. CLI API

### `zfs-drive-backup`

Helper tool for easily backing up ZFS datasets to external hard drives using zfs send

| Flag / Argument  | Type   | Required | Default | Description                                                                              |
| ---------------- | ------ | -------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `-c`, `--config` | `PATH` | No       | `-`     | Path to the JSON configuration file (defaults to ~/.config/zfs-drive-backup/config.json) |
| `-e`, `--export` | `-`    | No       | `-`     | Export the external ZFS backup pool after completing the backup                          |

## 3. Configuration Formats

### `[backup-config]` (_config.json_)

User configuration specifying datasets to back up and candidate external backup pools.

| Key            | Value Type       | Default   | Description                                                     |
| -------------- | ---------------- | --------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `datasets`     | `Vec<String>`    | `-`       | ZFS datasets to back up.                                        |
| `machine_name` | `Option<String>` | `default` | Optional machine name override for the target dataset prefix.   |
| `pools`        | `Vec<String>`    | `-`       | Candidate external ZFS backup pool names to discover and mount. |
